subagent_id.description: Optional: the subagent ID that produced this result.

role.description: Optional: the role the subagent was dispatched as.

runtime.description: Optional: the runtime that executed the subagent.

summary.description: Optional: human-readable one-sentence summary of the result.

questions.description: Optional: questions the subagent could not resolve, routed to autopilot.

capability_unconstrained_verdict.description: Optional: path to the capability-unconstrained verdict capsule (.harness/runs/*/capability-unconstrained/verdict.json) that was active when this result was produced. Populated at closeout to record the gate verdict against this work order.
